const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive client/controller for the RoboCasa GR1 standard episode.
+
+Start with ``python -u /app/output/gen.py``.  The process keeps one Robot
+client open and reads one JSON command per line from stdin.  Supported commands:
+
+  {"op":"observe", "seconds":0, "cameras":[...], "video":"frames"}
+  {"op":"submit", "rows":[[24 values], ...], "note":"..."}
+  {"op":"hold", "right":[6 pose values], "left":[6 pose values],
+   "right_hand":[6], "left_hand":[6], "n":20, "note":"..."}
+  {"op":"status"}
+
+Pose values are base-frame x,y,z,rx,ry,rz.  A hold command submits one row
+repeated n times using the native ee_pose action.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import traceback
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+(OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+print("CONNECTED", robot.base, flush=True)
+print("SPEC", json.dumps({k: spec.get(k) for k in (
+    "protocol", "control_dt", "max_control_steps", "max_chunk_s", "max_watch_s",
+    "action_types", "proprio_layout", "budget", "cameras")}, default=str), flush=True)
+
+cameras = list(spec.get("cameras", {}))
+initial = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=True, video="frames")
+initial.save(str(OUT / "initial"))
+print("INITIAL_META", json.dumps(initial.meta, default=str), flush=True)
+print("PROPRIO_LAYOUT", json.dumps(initial.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("layout", [])), flush=True)
+print("PROPRIO_NOW", json.dumps(initial.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])), flush=True)
+print("READY", flush=True)
+
+call_no = 0
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    line = line.strip()
+    if not line:
+        continue
+    try:
+        cmd = json.loads(line)
+        op = cmd.get("op")
+        if op == "status":
+            print("RESULT", json.dumps(robot.status(), default=str), flush=True)
+            continue
+        if op == "observe":
+            cams = cmd.get("cameras", cameras)
+            obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)),
+                                video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 10)),
+                                include_depth=bool(cmd.get("include_depth", False)),
+                                video=cmd.get("video", "frames"))
+        elif op == "submit":
+            actions = np.asarray(cmd["rows"], dtype=np.float64)
+            obs = robot.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=cmd.get("dt"),
+                               interpolate=cmd.get("interpolate", "hold"),
+                               cameras=cmd.get("cameras", cameras[:1]),
+                               video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 10)),
+                               video=cmd.get("video", "frames"),
+                               include_depth=bool(cmd.get("include_depth", False)),
+                               note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+        elif op == "hold":
+            right = list(cmd["right"])
+            left = list(cmd["left"])
+            rh = list(cmd.get("right_hand", [0.0] * 6))
+            lh = list(cmd.get("left_hand", [0.0] * 6))
+            row = right + left + rh + lh
+            if len(row) != 24:
+                raise ValueError(f"hold assembled {len(row)} action values, expected 24")
+            n = int(cmd.get("n", 20))
+            if n < 1 or n > round(float(spec.get("max_chunk_s", 10.0)) / float(spec["control_dt"])):
+                raise ValueError("n outside one chunk")
+            obs = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.repeat(np.asarray(row)[None, :], n, axis=0),
+                               interpolate="hold", cameras=cmd.get("cameras", cameras[:1]),
+                               video_fps=int(cmd.get("video_fps", 10)),
+                               video=cmd.get("video", "frames"),
+                               include_depth=bool(cmd.get("include_depth", False)),
+                               note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown op {op!r}")
+        call_no += 1
+        obs.save(str(OUT / f"call_{call_no:03d}"))
+        print("RESULT", json.dumps(obs.meta, default=str), flush=True)
+        print("PROPRIO_LAYOUT", json.dumps(obs.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("layout", [])), flush=True)
+        print("PROPRIO_NOW", json.dumps(obs.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now", [])), flush=True)
+        print("SAVED", str(OUT / f"call_{call_no:03d}"), flush=True)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print("ERROR", repr(exc), flush=True)
+        traceback.print_exc(file=sys.stdout)
+        print("READY", flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
